name: Clean The Cleaners
author: thewazaa
description:
History
To clean is your life.

You have a heavy Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) that doesn't let you feel well with the world if your house is not clean and something is out of order.

So, when you had to leave your house for a business trip and had to leave your family alone at home, you contacted a cleaning agency to make sure that your house would be clean when you came back.

And you left.

And you came back.

And the cleaning agency was not what it seemed. At your back, you found your family, your wife, your child, your dog, killed and sliced.

And the house was a mess, filled in blood, with everything in complete disorder.

And it is this disorder, not the death of your family, that requires revenge.

Controls
Movement: Left stick, WASD keys, arrow keys
Rotation: Right stick, Mouse
Jump: North button, space key
Action: East button, Alt key (avoid to use it if you run the game in the web browser), E key
Run: Left trigger, shift key
Shoot: Right trigger: left button
Outside this game, avoid drinking bleach to regain your health. IT DOES NOT WORK
